select t.device_code as deviceCode,m.pic_sensor_length as picSensorLength,m.pic_sensor_width as picSensorWidth,m.min_focus as minFocus from vm_device_info_t t LEFT JOIN vm_device_model_t m on t.model_code=m.mfgr_code and t.device_model_code=m.device_model_code where t.delete_flag=0 and t.device_code = #{deviceCode}

select t.device_code as deviceCode,m.pic_sensor_length as picSensorLength,m.pic_sensor_width as picSensorWidth,m.min_focus as minFocus from vm_device_info_t t LEFT JOIN vm_device_model_t m on t.model_code=m.mfgr_code and t.device_model_code=m.device_model_code where t.delete_flag=0 and m.device_model_code is not null and t.device_code = #{deviceCode}

SELECT b.area_id, b.area_name, a.tenant_id, b.points_p, b.points_t, b.points_z, b.points, b.position_information, c.tenant_name FROM vm_alarm_suppress_strategy a LEFT JOIN vm_alarm_area_suppress b on a.id = b.alarm_suppress_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info c on a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE a.delete_flag='0' and b.delete_flag='0' and a.industry_code = #{industryCode,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and b.channel_code = #{channelCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
